### Launch

# Design Arena Launches: \#1 Benchmark for AI Design

By

### David J. Phillips

·

February 9, 2026

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/691672e8696835fde83bf394/698467c3acf7c3ee21e05193_688d6715424e5701a42abdc6_designarena%2520founders%2520resized.jpeg)

[Design Arena](https://www.designarena.ai/) recently [launched](https://www.ycombinator.com/launches/O5h-design-arena-1-benchmark-for-ai-design)!

[![Launch YC: Design Arena - #1 Benchmark for AI Design](https://www.ycombinator.com/launches/O5h-design-arena-1-benchmark-for-ai-design/upvote_embed.svg)](https://www.ycombinator.com/launches/O5h-design-arena-1-benchmark-for-ai-design)

‍

##### _"Attracted 47K+ users across 136 countries in 4 weeks."_ **_‍_**

‍

###### **_📣 TLDR_** [**_Design Arena_**](https://www.designarena.ai/) **_is the first crowdsourced benchmark for AI-generated design. They evaluate how models perform on real-world design tasks - frontend, audio, image, video and more - with live, organic users. It’s the first step of their broader mission at_** [**_Arcada Labs_**](http://arcada.dev/) **_to distill and understand the human experience._**

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/691672e8696835fde83bf394/698467c3acf7c3ee21e0513a_688d67f8c280367ca29c64b4_Design%2520arena1.png)

**Image Credits:** [**Design Arena**](https://www.designarena.ai/)

‍

‍ **Founded by** [**Grace Li**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/grace-li-721a4017b/) **,** [**Kamryn Ohly**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kamrynohly/) **&** [**Jayden Personnat**](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jayden-p-8956911b8/)

**‍**

#### **💛 Team**

The founders are all best friends from Harvard!

**Jayden Personnat** (pictured in the back): Chief AI/ML — Harvard Computer Science & Statistics, previously at Nvidia.

**Kamryn Ohly**(pictured on the right): CTO — Harvard Computer Science & Education, previously at Apple.

**Grace Li**(pictured on the left): CEO — Harvard Computer Science & Neuroscience, previously at Apple.

‍

#### **❌ Problem**

LLMs can pass bar exams and win IMO gold, but they still generate UIs with white text on a white background.

There’s no standard to measure taste, usability, or aesthetics, and no benchmark means no pressure to improve.

‍

#### **🏆 Solution**

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ay89pA\_wUHM](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ay89pA_wUHM)

‍

At [Design Arena](https://www.designarena.ai/) they are building the definitive benchmark for AI-generated design.

- Users vote in real time on model-generated designs.
- [Design Arena](https://www.designarena.ai/) computes pairwise comparisons, Elo rankings, and leaderboard scores.
- Companies can track performance, run private evals, and iterate faster.

[Design Arena](https://www.designarena.ai/) handles all the hard parts: experimental design, statistical significance, scaling, and integration.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/691672e8696835fde83bf394/698467c3acf7c3ee21e05136_688d6a27c28dc2574cdf5a01_Design%2520arena2.png)

**Image Credits:** [**Design Arena**](https://www.designarena.ai/)

‍
